root.label: Iterator categories and concepts
root.note: Two taxonomies: legacy named requirements tagged by iterator_category, C++20 concepts tagged by iterator_concept.

children.label: Legacy ladder
children.note: Input, forward, bidirectional, random access, contiguous; output on the side.

children.label: Multi-pass
children.note: Forward adds it: copies advance independently and a == b implies ++a == ++b.

children.label: True reference rule
children.note: Cpp17ForwardIterator requires *it to be T& or const T&, which proxies cannot meet.

children.label: Tag is trusted
children.note: Nothing checks iterator_category; vector<bool> iterators claim random access anyway.

children.label: C++20 concepts
children.note: Checked by the compiler and built from indirectly_readable, incrementable and sentinel_for.

children.label: Weaker input
children.note: input_iterator may be move-only, lack ==, and have a void postfix ++.

children.label: Forward without T&
children.note: forward_iterator needs regular and multi-pass, but any reference type.

children.label: Contiguous needs lvalue
children.note: contiguous_iterator requires an lvalue reference and working std::to_address.

children.label: ITER_CONCEPT
children.note: Reads iterator_concept, then iterator_category, else random access for primary traits.

children.label: Proxy iterators
children.note: An iterator can be random access by concept and input by category.

children.label: views::transform
children.note: By-value result: concept follows the base range, category is input_iterator_tag.

children.label: vector<bool>
children.note: Models random_access_iterator but never contiguous_iterator; reference is a proxy.

children.label: Pointers
children.note: iterator_traits<T*> reports random access category and contiguous concept.

children.label: Associated types
children.note: Prefer the C++20 aliases over iterator_traits members.

children.label: iter_value_t
children.note: cv-qualifiers removed: iter_value_t<const int*> is int.

children.label: iter_reference_t
children.note: Exactly decltype(*it), such as const int& for const int*.

children.label: iter_rvalue_reference_t
children.note: Type of ranges::iter_move(it); int&& for int*.

children.label: Traits specialization wins
children.note: A user specialization of iterator_traits overrides the computed traits.

children.label: Operations and cost
children.note: advance, distance, next and prev hide the category but not the cost.

children.label: Linear below random
children.note: std::distance on a list walks every node, even though size() is O(1).

children.label: Negative advance
children.note: Undefined behavior unless the iterator is at least bidirectional.

children.label: ranges::distance
children.note: Constant time whenever the sentinel models sized_sentinel_for.

children.label: Output iterators
children.note: Write-only and single pass, such as back_insert_iterator and ostream_iterator.

children.label: void value_type
children.note: iter_value_t is unusable, but difference_type is ptrdiff_t since C++20.

children.label: output_iterator<I, T>
children.note: Takes the written type as a parameter because acceptance depends on it.
